1385-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.

Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

4068-5078-6918-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.

1379-4186-6830-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-4186-6830-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.

Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.

1274-5789-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5789-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4050-5929-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4050-5929-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Leyline of Transformation, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2440-4758-7546.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {U}{R}, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste that enters prepared.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Lizard or Wizard creature you control.
If needed, activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U/R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 an additional time.
Repeat.
2440-4758-7546.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional creature you control that is a Lizard or Wizard.

280-1558-2557-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-2557-3875-4231.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

5147-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5147-5687-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
5147-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Goblin Bombardment.

250-730-779-1479-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-730-779-1479-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1453-2387-3490-6791.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-6791.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.

Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-5220-5231-6535.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1796-4484-4871-5643-5686.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-4484-4871-5643-5686.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-4484-4871-5643-5686.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

856-2921-4321-5632.description:

Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.

Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Romana II trigger, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.

1031-3258-3557.notablePrerequisites: Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked an opponent.
1031-3258-3557.description:
Deal combat damage using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

1883-4772.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a creature token.

Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Doubling Season.

Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.

Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is tapped and attacking.
The Dockside Extortionist token(s) enter the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
At the end of your combat phase, the Dockside Extortionist token triggers, exiling itself.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

Repeat each turn.

249-1173-1984.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, copying all cards you own in exile with kick counters on them and allowing you to cast the copies.
Cast the Final Fortune and Angel's Grace copies by paying {W}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Final Fortune copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the end of the extra turn.
Resolve the Angel's Grace copy, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers, however you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Repeat each turn.

11-2196-2492-3075.notablePrerequisites:
You control three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
You have at least one experience counter.
11-2196-2492-3075.description:

If you have less than three experience counters, Mizzix triggers, giving you an experience counter.
Resolve Bonus Round, causing you to copy each instant and sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {U}.
If you have less than three experience counters, Mizzix triggers, giving you an experience counter.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Frantic Search.
Bonus Round triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Frantic Search and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Frantic Search and returning it to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, looting twice and untapping three lands you control that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
Activate the three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

1259-2103.notablePrerequisites: You do not have any instants or sorceries in your graveyard.
1259-2103.description:

Charmbreaker Devils triggers, gaining +4/+0 until end of turn.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Charmbreaker Devils triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Repeat.

1421-3763-4663.notablePrerequisites: Another 5+ power creature in hand.5+ lands on the battlefield.
1421-3763-4663.description:
Cast Baru and make a token of it with Bramble Sovereign, sacrifice the original.
Play power 5 creature to return Baru to hand with Paleoloth.
Discard Baru to the Baru token making a worm and returning Baru to hand.
